finalText:
I opened major incident INC-1 for the company-wide CI outage and ran every step of the current runbook (KB-40). The 2025 edition, KB-39, has been replaced, so I didn't use it. The first status update is published and promises the next one at **15:50 UTC**, so someone needs to post it by then.

1. **Incident opened:** INC-1 (build-pipeline) was opened at 15:20 UTC, before I contacted anyone.
2. **Commander:** I paged E-401 Priya Raman, who is on call for incident command right now, and made her commander. Per the runbook, I picked her by the current time, not by any ticket deadline. She was the only person paged.
3. **Reports linked:** these seven tickets all describe the missing build runners: T-3101, T-3102, T-3103, T-3104, T-3105, T-3106 and T-3109.
   - I kept two look-alikes out. T-3107 is a flaky payments-service test that was reported before the outage. T-3108 is one person's local build failing after an Xcode upgrade. I didn't change either.
4. **Severity:** all seven linked reports are now sev1. Deadlines already promised to requesters stayed as they were. T-3106 and T-3109 had no deadline, so they got the handbook's triage deadline: 15:20 plus the 60-minute sev1 target, which is 16:20 UTC.
5. **Comms lead:** the comms rota names E-801 Mia Laurent, but she is on sick leave today. Its backup rotation, comms-secondary, covers, so I named E-803 Elif Demir, who is on call there now.
6. **First status update:** "Impact: All CI builds company-wide are failing: no build runners are available, so pipelines in every repository are stuck. Started: 14:52 UTC. Next update: 15:50 UTC." The start time is when the first report came in.
7. **Postmortem:** I created T-3115, linked to INC-1 and due 2026-04-08 at 17:00 UTC. That is the close of the 5th business day after 30 March, skipping Good Friday (3 April), the weekend and Easter Monday (6 April).

The postmortem ticket has no assignee. Platform-primary, the team that owns build-pipeline, has no published on-call shift covering its deadline, so it needs to be assigned once that rota is published. I didn't merge the duplicate reports, because the runbook calls for linking them to the incident instead.
